request.spec:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The rate calendar is in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests (the main "rate calendar" test and its three scenarios).

**What it shows:** a table in the Rates section, under the current rates. It has one row per grade (A, B and C) and one column per month of the year the sheet's today falls in. Each cell has the rate in force on the first of that month, or `n/a` if none is. Each cell's `data-testid` is `rate-month-<grade>-<yyyy-mm>`, as the test expects.

**How it works:** the cells use the same `rateFor` lookup as the existing "current rate" display. So the calendar follows the rules already in place:
- a newer from-date takes over from an older one;
- a rate stops applying after its to-date;
- a rate can be inherited from parent sheets.

For example, a 10.00 rate from 2026-02-15 followed by 20.00 from 05-01 to 07-31 shows `n/a` for January and February, 10.00 for March and April, 20.00 for May to July, and `n/a` from August on.

The only file changed is the front end, `src/main/frontend/features/rates/rates.slot.tsx`. It needed no new stored data, server endpoint or audit record.
